_help: Copy this file to candidate_profile.json in the repo root and fill in your details. This file is tracked; candidate_profile.json is gitignored.
name: Your Name
_triage_help: triage_stack is shown to the LLM for fast yes/no triage (Step 1). Keep it short — one line of comma-separated technologies.
triage_stack: Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, React/TS, AWS, Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, microservices
triage_not_in_stack: Go/Golang, Ruby, PHP, Android/iOS/React Native/Flutter, Solidity/blockchain, .NET/C#
_strengths_help: Used verbatim in the SCORE prompt. Be specific — the LLM does literal keyword lookup. Each string is one 'competency area'.
hard_gaps: Machine learning / model training / MLOps / data science
Business Intelligence / BI Engineer / Analytics Engineer / Data Analyst
QA / SDET / test automation as primary role
Production support / application support / L1-L2-L3 / NOC / ops shift work
_seniority_help: Titles matching seniority_cap_pattern are hard-capped at seniority_cap score. tier1_bonus is added for tier1_companies (applied before cap). Senior/Sr must NOT appear in the cap pattern — they score on merit.
_tier1_help: Companies that receive tier1_bonus points. Add well-known product companies you want to prioritise. Regex strings — \b for word boundary, special chars must be escaped.
_middleman_help: Companies that are staffing agencies / platforms. These go to the 'Via Staffing' section of the queue instead of the Direct section.
_role_skip_help: Regex patterns matched against job titles. Matching roles are dropped entirely (not even agency-listed).
_ollama_help: Local Ollama setup. Run `ollama serve` and `ollama pull <model>` before the pipeline.
_paths_help: All paths relative to the repo root. data/ is gitignored — these files are personal.
